records.name: John Hauser
records.priorTitle: Administrator/engineer within NCCCS (specific prior role not confirmed)
records.notes: Current (9th) president; assumed role June 2020 after 30+ years in the NC Community College System; engineering/advanced manufacturing background.

records.name: Patricia Skinner
records.notes: 8th president; Gaston College's first female president; retired March 2020 as the longest-tenured president in school history.

records.name: Wayne Scott
records.notes: 6th president, served before Skinner (dates not confirmed); retired from the role. Paul Berrier also briefly served as interim president in this era.

seats.university: George C Wallace State Community College-Hanceville

records.name: Vicki P. Hawsey (Karolewics)
records.notes: Current (3rd) president since 2003, per Wikipedia listed as Vicki Hawsey Karolewics.

records.name: James C. Bailey
records.notes: Appointed president February 16, 1971; served until retirement in 2003.

records.name: Ben Johnson
records.notes: First leader (Director) of the institution, then named George C. Wallace State Trade School of Cullman County; classes began 1966.

records.name: Juston Pate
records.notes: Current Chancellor (title updated from 'President' under KCTCS system restructuring); became leader of ECTC in 2017; has 25-year career in education. Predecessor's name/dates could not be confirmed from available sources; ECTC was formed in 2004 by merger of Elizabethtown Community College and Elizabethtown Technical College.

records.name: Towuanna Porter Brannon
records.notes: Named the college's ninth president, effective January 2021 (institution renamed from Thomas Nelson Community College to Virginia Peninsula Community College in 2021). Names/dates of predecessors (1st-8th presidents, under the Thomas Nelson CC lineage) could not be confirmed from available sources.

records.name: Deborah Preston
records.priorTitle: Provost and Vice President of Academic Affairs
records.notes: Current (7th) president of MCCC; succeeded Jianping Wang.

records.name: Jianping Wang
records.notes: 6th president; began April 2016; placed on paid administrative leave in late 2021 amid a faculty no-confidence vote and board controversy, ending her tenure before a scheduled 2022 contract end.

records.name: Patricia C. Donohue
records.priorInstitution: Mercer County Community College (internal, 49-year career at MCCC)
records.notes: Served approximately 8 years as president before retiring, capping a 49-year career at the college; succeeded by Jianping Wang effective July 1, 2016.

records.name: L. Marshall Washington
records.notes: Third president of KVCC, named March 15, 2018.

records.name: Marilyn Schlack
records.notes: Second president; served 35 years, retiring in 2017.

records.name: Dale B. Lake
records.notes: Founding (first) president, served March 1, 1967 to October 1, 1982.

records.name: Laura Treanor
records.notes: Fifth president of VWCC; began July 1, 2025, succeeding Robert Sandel who retired in June 2025.

records.name: Robert Sandel
records.notes: Fourth president; became the longest-serving president in VWCC history and the most tenured in the VCCS system; retired 2025.

records.name: Charles Downs
records.notes: Served as president 1981-2001, preceding Robert Sandel.

records.name: Karissa M. Morehouse
records.notes: Named acting/interim president effective July 1, 2026, following Tawny Dotson's departure; expected to serve ~1 year during a national search.

records.name: Tawny Dotson
records.notes: Served as president from July 2020 until 2026, when she departed to become president-superintendent of Mt. San Jacinto Community College (CA). Retired Lt. Colonel, USAF.

records.name: G.H. Javaheripour
records.notes: President from February 2015 until resignation in early March 2020; Judy Walters served as bridge interim president March-July 2020 before Dotson started.

seats.university: City Colleges of Chicago-Richard J Daley College

records.name: Isaac Zuniga
records.notes: Selected as the next president of Daley College around May 2026, succeeding Janine Janosky. Exact start date/prior role not fully confirmed.

records.name: Janine E. Janosky
records.notes: Served as president of Daley College preceding Isaac Zuniga; exact start year not confirmed from available sources (each CCC campus president is selected by the CCC chancellor and approved by the board).

records.name: José Aybar
records.priorTitle: Associate Vice Chancellor for Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Became Daley College president in August 2009; retained during the 2011 CCC leadership reorganization under Mayor Rahm Emanuel when most campus presidents were replaced. End year at Daley and successor between him and Janosky not confirmed.

records.name: Denise Richardson
records.notes: Began her role as BCC president July 1, 2023; over 20 years of experience within the Peralta Community College District.

records.name: Angélica Garcia
records.notes: Served as BCC president prior to Denise Richardson (referenced in Peralta board materials as of April 2022); exact start date not confirmed.

records.name: Vincent G. June
records.notes: Selected as next SLCC Chancellor in December 2020 (took office 2021), succeeding Natalie Harder.

records.name: Natalie Harder
records.notes: Chancellor of SLCC from 2012 to May 29, 2020; led the merger of community and technical colleges into SLCC and grew enrollment from 6,100 to over 18,000 students.

records.name: Patrick M. Jones
records.notes: Sixth president; began July 1, 2024, unanimously approved by the board after a national search.

records.name: Felicia Ganther
records.notes: Served less than three years as president; resigned in December 2023 citing personal reasons, following a faculty union no-confidence vote.

records.name: James J. Linksz
records.notes: Second president of Bucks County Community College (long-tenured), preceding Felicia Ganther; exact start/end years and any interim bridge to Ganther not confirmed. Founding president was Charles E. Rollins.

records.name: Ann D. Bieber
records.priorTitle: Senior Vice President of Administrative Services / Dean of Continuing Education
records.notes: Fifth president, appointed July 10, 2014; LCCC's first female president; joined LCCC in 1981.

records.name: Donald Snyder
records.notes: Served as president from 2000 through December 31, 2013, immediately preceding Ann Bieber.

records.name: Ivan L. Harrell II
records.notes: Became TCC president May 1, 2018 (11th president); college archive records list him starting in 2017 in one source.

records.name: Sheila Ruhland
records.notes: Served as president 2014-2017, between Pamela Transue and Ivan Harrell, per TCC archive records.

records.name: Pamela J. Transue
records.notes: Served as president from 1997, retiring in 2014 after 17 years of service.

records.name: Irvin T. Clark
records.notes: Appointed president by Technical College System of Georgia Commissioner Greg Dozier in April 2022; named to Georgia Trend's 500 Most Influential Leaders for 2025.

records.name: Alvetta Peterman Thomas
records.notes: Became SCTC president in 2016, moving from the presidency of Atlanta Technical College (where she served since 2008).

records.name: Carey Castle
records.priorInstitution: Kentucky Community and Technical College System
records.notes: Current Chancellor (title updated under KCTCS system restructuring from 'President'); described as a veteran KCTCS educator/administrator. Exact appointment year and predecessor's name/dates could not be confirmed from available sources.

records.name: Jana Schwartz
records.notes: Current president of PVCC (Maricopa Community College District campus). Exact appointment year and predecessor's name/dates could not be confirmed from available sources; college's own site pages were inaccessible during this research.
